verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented data-residency or region-selection capability for Crawl4AI. The Dockerized self-hosted server and the open-source library let users run it on infrastructure they choose, but location control then comes from the user's own hosting, not from a product residency feature. This adjacent workaround earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
